Clemontic Gear (Japanese: シトロニックギア Citronic Gear) refers to several different inventions held inside 's backpack, as featured throughout . These inventions are typically used to help and overcome obstacles and solve various problems encountered during their . 

Clemont usually introduced his new invention by saying, "The future is now, thanks to science! Clemontic Gear, ON!" followed by stating the name of the invention and explaining how it works. By means of a , Clemont's inventions often exploded or failed to work, with only a few inventions actually proving successful. Despite this, Ash always became enthralled with Clemont's inventions, always saying, "Wow! Science is so amazing!" Occasionally, there was an environmental circumstance that caused the invention to fail, but most of the time it was because the invention was not completely finished yet. Clemont tended to give either very obvious or very long and unpractical names to his inventions, often to the annoyance of .

In this article, an invention will be noted as a success if it did the job it was intended to do and did not malfunction or explode. If the invention is noted as a failure, that means it completely failed to carry out the task it was intended to do, either by malfunctioning or blowing up. If the outcome of an invention is deemed imprecise, it means that the invention at least partially managed to carry out its task but still malfunctioned or blew up.

==Trivia==
Clemont has made a total of 70 inventions in the entirety of the animated series.
35.71% (25 out of 70) of Clemont's inventions were proven successful.
If you count his inventions with imprecise results as successful, then 61.43% (43/70) of his inventions were successful
38.57% (27 out of 70) of Clemont's inventions were proven failures.
If you count his inventions with imprecise results as failures, then 64.29% (45/70) of his inventions were failures.
25.71% (18 out of 70) of Clemont's inventions were proven imprecise.
